content.title: Is Kohl’s closed on Easter?
content.text: Key PointsKohl's stores are closed Easter Sunday, joining Thanksgiving and Christmas as full shutdown days.The By Kohl’s campaign unites proprietary brands for easy, affordable holiday shopping.Spring brings new clothing lines, beauty drops, and home essentials to Kohl’s stores. If picking up a new outfit is a part of your Easter traditions, there’s no better place to shop than Kohl’s. The department store has the whole family covered, with a large selection of brands that run the gamut from casual to dressy, ensuring you’ll find the perfect look for whatever your holiday entails. Kohl’s is also one of the most budget-friendly retailers for your Easter outfits, thanks to its newly launched By Kohl’s campaign. The campaign brings together all of the department stores’ proprietary brands — including LC by Lauren Conrad, Simply Vera Vera Wang, FLX, Sea + Sky, and Jumping Beans — under a single banner, making it easier than ever to find high-quality, affordable options. But if you’re still on the hunt for a last-minute look, you’d better hurry. All Kohl’s locations will be closed on Easter Sunday. Kohl’s treats Easter Sunday as a full shutdown, closing all 1,100+ of its locations for the entire day. The holiday joins Thanksgiving and Christmas as one of three days each year the retailer takes a break and all employees have the day off. For the days surrounding the Easter holiday, you can check the opening hours of your local Kohl’s here. Kohl’s has locations in 49 states (there are currently no stores in Hawaii), that serve more than 60 million customers. Nearly 80% of Americans live within 15 miles of a Kohl’s store, according to the company. All Kohl’s locations will be closed on Easter Sunday 2026.Getty Images Kohl’s has fresh offerings for spring If you didn’t make it to Kohl’s in time to buy your Easter outfit this year, it’s still well worth a trip to the retailer after the holiday is over. Kohl’s has a huge lineup of new arrivals this spring, including the introduction of two new lines, FLX Golf for Men and Sea + Sky for tween girls. The men’s big and tall assortment has also seen a full overhaul, with a refreshed lineup of items for the gym, the office, and everywhere in between. Beauty lovers will be excited to note that the Sephora at Kohl’s selection has expanded, with new drops from MAC Cosmetics and YSL Beauty. And if you’re looking to freshen up your home for the season, the Caro Home collection has a wide selection of bedding and bath essentials perfect for the sunnier months.
